contexts.text: Had supposed that they could penetrate all things.
The Word... penetrates to the inmosts.
The truths of faith with them... do not penetrate to the affection...
The things of love and faith do not (then) penetrate to his interiors.
The light of Heaven (thus) penetrates... also to the spiritual.
The evil not of fault... does not penetrate to the interiors.
The ideas and little affections... penetrate into Societies. Explained.
After temptation, truth and good penetrate towards the interiors...
A holy external without an internal penetrates only to the first threshold of Heaven... But a holy external from an internal penetrates into Heaven...
Wanted to penetrate into Divine arcana by scientifics...
(These representatives) penetrate the Spirit from the interiors... to the exteriors...
A Spirit or Angel can (then) penetrate by sight into the lowest things.
Man has not penetrated with his thought deeper than into the interior things of nature.
The Divine... has (now) penetrated into the ultimates of nature.
The reading of the Word by these, penetrates into Heaven...
That the words of God Messiah penetrate to the Heavens, and to the... inmosts of Spirits and Angels. Explained.
No one can judge concerning the life of another from... his penetration into Things...
Supposing that he could... penetrate the thoughts of Spirits.
They desire to penetrate at once to the most arcane things...
Men do not penetrate the thoughts of others much; but Spirits do so much more...
It is a fallacy that maia or Spirit can, with his thought or art, penetrate into Heaven, or into spiritual and celestial things. Explained.
Infested by those who would by their filthy phantasies penetrate the inmost things of faith.
The Lord's Providence can never be penetrated.
His idea did not penetrate more interiorly.
The ancient auguries... could not penetrate further than to the lowest form...
God 8. 11. Evils... do not penetrate to the Divine things which are within.
